snippet.title: Wide Sky - iPhone/iPod Touch/iPad HD Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wide Sky by Marcus Eckert

A Game about Hedgehogs and Ropes.

Features:

- 11 different Ropes.
- tweak the Rope Physics
- 6 Special Powers
- 40+ Mini Challenges
- detailed Animation
- built-in Stats
- procedural World
